## Commonly Asked Questions

Q: What are your hours?
A: We are open 7 days a week from 9 AM to 10 PM.

Q: Where are you located?
A: 7147 Indian Line Rd, Norfolk County, ON N0E 1Z0 in Six Nations, Ontario.

Q: What age do I need to be?
A: You must be 19 years or older to enter and purchase.

Q: Are your products tested?
A: Yes, all cannabis products are lab-tested for quality and safety.

Q: Do you offer delivery?
A: Please email us at info@healingroomsixnations.ca or use our AI chat assistant for delivery inquiries.

Q: What strains help with sleep?
A: Indica strains are generally recommended for relaxation and sleep. Popular sleep-inducing strains include those with "Kush", "Purple", or "OG" in the name.

Q: What strains are good for energy?
A: Sativa strains typically provide uplifting and energizing effects. Look for strains with "Haze", "Diesel", or "Jack" in the name.
